name: harmonic-match
description: Dating app that matches users based on musical taste compatibility, conflict resolution styles, and psychological frameworks. Where your playlist meets your perfect match - combining Spotify integration, personality assessments, and AI compatibility analysis.

userStories.title: Project Setup & Infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the base Next.js 14 project for the music-based dating app.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind CSS with music-inspired palette (deep purples, electric blues, warm oranges)
shadcn/ui with button, card, avatar, slider, tabs components
Environment variables for Supabase and Spotify API

userStories.title: Database Schema Design
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the schema for users, music profiles, and compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: user_profiles table (id, user_id, display_name, age, gender, location, bio, photos_json, created_at)
music_profiles table (id, user_id, spotify_connected, top_artists_json, top_genres_json, audio_features_avg_json, music_personality)
conflict_styles table (id, user_id, primary_style, secondary_style, assessment_json)
personality_assessments table (id, user_id, framework, scores_json, created_at)
compatibility_scores table (id, user1_id, user2_id, music_score, conflict_score, personality_score, overall_score)
matches table (id, user1_id, user2_id, user1_liked, user2_liked, matched_at)
messages table (id, conversation_id, sender_id, content, song_share_json, created_at)
shared_playlists table (id, match_id, spotify_playlist_id, name, created_at)
Seed data for conflict styles and personality frameworks

userStories.title: Authentication System
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sign up and connect my Spotify account.
acceptanceCriteria: Spotify OAuth integration for music data
Signup page at /signup with Spotify connect CTA
Auth context managing user and Spotify tokens

userStories.title: Landing Page
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to understand the unique music-based matching.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero: 'Where Your Playlist Meets Your Perfect Match'
Value prop: Match on music taste, conflict style, and psychology
3 matching dimensions explained: Music, Conflict, Personality
CTA to sign up and connect Spotify
Mobile responsive with audio waveform design elements

userStories.title: Spotify Integration & Music Profile
userStories.description: As a user, I want to connect Spotify and build my music profile.
acceptanceCriteria: OAuth flow to get Spotify access token
Fetch user's top 20 artists (short, medium, long term)
Fetch user's top 50 tracks with audio features
Calculate average audio features (danceability, energy, valence, etc.)
Display music profile summary with top artists/genres

userStories.title: Profile Creation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create my dating profile with photos and bio.

userStories.title: Conflict Resolution Assessment
userStories.description: As a user, I want to complete an assessment about my conflict style.
acceptanceCriteria: 5 conflict styles: Competing, Collaborating, Compromising, Avoiding, Accommodating
Each answer maps to style scores

userStories.title: Personality Assessment
userStories.description: As a user, I want to complete a personality assessment for matching.
acceptanceCriteria: 15 questions based on Big Five personality traits
Traits: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism

userStories.title: Compatibility Algorithm
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be matched based on all three dimensions.
acceptanceCriteria: Music score: genre overlap, audio feature similarity, artist matches
Conflict score: complementary styles (e.g., collaborating pairs well)
Personality score: compatible Big Five patterns
Overall score: weighted average (music 40%, conflict 30%, personality 30%)
Calculate against all users matching basic preferences
Trigger on profile completion and periodically

userStories.title: Discover Feed
userStories.description: As a user, I want to browse potential matches in a swipe-style feed.
acceptanceCriteria: Discover page at /discover with card stack UI
Each card shows: photos, name, age, location, music personality, top artists
Swipe right to like, left to pass (or buttons)
Filter options: age range, distance, minimum compatibility
Empty state when no more profiles

userStories.title: Profile View with Compatibility Breakdown
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see detailed compatibility analysis on profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Music compatibility: shared genres, similar vibes, artist overlap visualization
Conflict compatibility: how your styles complement
'Soundtrack' showing their top 5 tracks (playable if Spotify connected)

userStories.title: Matching & Likes System
userStories.description: As a user, I want to match with people who like me back.
acceptanceCriteria: Like action saved to matches table
Check for mutual like on each like
Matches page at /matches showing all mutual matches
Each match card shows compatibility and conversation preview

userStories.title: Messaging with Song Sharing
userStories.description: As a matched user, I want to chat and share songs.
acceptanceCriteria: Share song button opening Spotify search
Song messages display with album art and play button

userStories.title: Shared Playlist Creation
userStories.description: As matched users, I want to create a shared playlist together.
acceptanceCriteria: Create collaborative Spotify playlist via API
Both users can add songs from chat

userStories.title: User Profile & Settings
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit my profile and manage settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit profile: photos, bio, basic info
Reconnect Spotify to refresh music data

userStories.title: Mobile Navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want smooth mobile navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom nav: Discover, Matches, Messages, Profile
